message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the configuration file contents or any incoming data before use.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice, and no checksum verification or source authentication is performed for the checkpoint or dataset files loaded locally.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is applied to the training data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_checkpoint function calls torch.load(checkpoint) directly with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; the file existence check even occurs after the file is already loaded.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, DP-SGD) are imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack code anywhere in the pipeline slice.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/val/test generators are created, there is no signed or hashed evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads datasets via DataLoader wrappers with no visible input shape, range, or schema validation before data is passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds anywhere in the visible inference/training path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a vision/classification model (CovidNet, CNN, ViT) for medical imaging, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
